largest_vegas_favorite.note: Largest Vegas favorite this week (-900 ML, ~87% raw implied) — by policy we don't crown a pick on raw favorite status alone. It went through the full Advocate/Skeptic/Arbiter debate and the Skeptic could not find a concrete counter-signal (the number held up as justified, not inflated), so it still ranks #1 post-debate at 0.86 — but the recommendation goes to the next-best team instead.

process_note: Each shortlisted team's case was built by an Advocate (live research), stress-tested by an independent Skeptic subagent looking only for flaws, and resolved by an independent Arbiter subagent that weighed both sides without seeing the raw research trail. Teams outside the top-10 shortlist got a lighter single-pass positives/negatives note instead of the full three-stage debate. Note: LA (Rams) was not shortlisted by the power-score ranking (a single lopsided Week 1 loss dragged its blended score down) despite carrying a real ~75% raw Vegas-implied probability vs. NYG — a possible gap in the shortlisting heuristic worth flagging to survivor-review.
